corrections.reason: The printed text clearly reads 'አይመረመርም፡' ('my nature cannot be scrutinized/investigated'), which Stage 1 scrambled into 'ይመረአመርም'.
Classical Ge'ez 1st-person pronoun with enclitic '-ሰ' is 'አነሰ' ('As for me'), and the printed glyph is 1st-order 'ነ' without the top hook of 'ን'.
The printed character is 'ፁ' ('ውፁእም', matching the repetition 'ውፁእ ፡ ነኝ' on the next line), misread as 'ዑ' due to ink fill in the upper loop of 'ፀ'.
